specialty_focus: Asahi Kasei Medical Asia Pacific is a regional arm of Asahi Kasei Medical Co., Ltd., specializing in blood purification and bioprocess technologies. It manufactures and distributes medical devices such as virus removal filters, leukocyte reduction filters, dialyzers, and therapeutic apheresis systems. It does not appear to focus on wearable medical devices.
